info.name: Hello Kitty Cutecore for K12
info.description:
Hello Kitty Background: Adds a pastel Hello Kitty background image.
Pink Color Palette: Various shades of pink for buttons, inputs, and text.
Cute Buttons: Rounded buttons with hover effects.
Custom Login Form: Inserts a Hello Kitty icon at the top of the login form.
Comic/Cute Fonts: Uses playful fonts like Comic Sans MS and Poppins.
Scroll Bar: Customized to match the pink theme.
Hope you like it
